findings.problem: protocolSha256 is accepted as metadata but never compared with actual copied protocol bytes; the effective bound configuration can differ from the reviewed protocol.
findings.requiredCorrection: Declare exact copied protocol path, compare its bytes to admission.protocolSha256 before SQL, validate effective hardcoded/load/query/log/time/threshold settings against that protocol, and bind all exact artifact hashes in the future closure.

findings.problem: indexedTenantPredicate accepts ANY index node containing the siteUUID; products only needs to exist elsewhere in the plan. An unrelated relation index can green a sequential products scan.
findings.requiredCorrection: Require actual products scan/index ancestry and the canonical tenant-ownership column equality bound to the exact requested site. Handle Bitmap Heap->Bitmap Index ancestry explicitly. Reject other-table, unrelated-column, filter-only, outer-plan and wrong-site fixtures. A generic parameterized predicate needs unambiguous verified scope binding, otherwise remain unproven.

findings.problem: The pre-HTTP full-public-table witness cannot remain byte-exact after9 real Worker requests with REQUEST_LOG_SAMPLE_RATE1 and settled observability. Existing qualified Circuit native source proves request-log and metric base/parent/leaf rows are legitimate writes.
findings.requiredCorrection: Preserve full witness for SQL-only measurements. For HTTP establish an immediate baseline, attribute only exact admitted requests by response request/trace ID to canonical operational base/parent/leaf families, verify exact cardinality/fields/mirrors and unchanged pre-existing rows; require all other tables unchanged. Do not blanket-ignore telemetry tables, disable observability or discard rows. Reuse existing qualified Circuit stage8 approach. After settling, compare a new complete witness across paired DOWN/UP and all read-only operations.

findings.problem: variantId is never asserted. Count1 can pass with the wrong product/variant; Worker checks only total and page-size, and RPC accounting is recorded without checking its expected calls or cache behavior.
findings.requiredCorrection: Validate actual canonical RPC payload with existing reader/schema; assert positive tuple productUUID and exact Graphite variantUUID/price in discovery.matches, both negative tuple cases, site ownership and expected page IDs/order/counts. Validate matching HTTP discovery and actual intended empty later pages. Assert actual browse RPC occurrence/count and a declared bounded dependency call shape; retain cache disposition and distinguish cached from executed requests. Compare equivalent result IDs for claimed before/after and feature/name comparisons.

findings.problem: A5ms log threshold may suppress fast successful inner plans even though every load requires a plan. The parser searches forward to the next brace after a matching PID header and could accept another record if that header has no JSON.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use a plan-only capture configuration that guarantees observing fast target statements, with strict volume/time bounds and no planner forcing. A zero-duration capture may be proposed only for the fresh synthetic plan session, with explicit bounded failure rather than broad log export. Parse one complete bounded record associated with the verified backendPID/time and canonical query; never skip into a later unrelated record. Add pure positive/negative parser tests for other PID, unrelated relation, missing/truncated JSON, braces in quoted strings, multiple records and generic scope ambiguity. Actual bundled-module/owned-log parser preflight remains a separate admission prerequisite.

findings.problem: Awaiting t.test does not throw a failed subtest automatically. Later phases and terminal allMatricesCompleted can run after an earlier failure, producing dependent actions and a misleading terminal receipt.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use the existing Circuit stage wrapper that rethrows captured failure after each subtest. Stop at the first failed dependency, retain failed/NOT_RUN phases and cleanup ownership, and emit success terminal/conservation only when all mandatory stages pass.
